user_decision.question: Continue the GHR separation route, or pivot to the MSO/Rabin decidability route?
user_decision.context: The task description asks for exactly this comparison before committing further effort, and the GHR route now has a precisely located obstruction rather than a hypothetical one: GHR 10.2.3's Cases 6-8 (the same `until` in both arguments of the `since`) have no candidate right-hand side, because their guard-failure condition is an exists-forall over the window below the evaluation point whose re-anchoring retains a forward-looking bounded conjunct that cannot be an S-guard. GHR 10.2.4 consumes all eight cases, so Theorem 10.2.9 and every deliverable resting on it are unreachable without them. The MSO/Rabin route reaches a decidability answer for the open language at .ZTime with no translation at all; if it holds, this task's remaining value is confined to making the definability verdict unconditional and to an executable tr.
options: Continue GHR: a successor dispatch proves the pinned, probed Case 5 candidate in the library (mathematically unblocked, recorded derivation, does not by itself reach 10.2.4), then attacks Cases 6-8 with either a published correct integer-flow form or a measure-carrying device bounding the re-anchoring chain.
